title: The Last Bus
scene_purpose: Mara asks Eli to leave town with her; his hesitation reveals that he already chose to stay.
premise_or_theme: A decision delayed is still a decision.

setting.location: A nearly empty roadside diner booth
established_geography: Mara sits on the window side of the booth
Eli sits opposite on the aisle side
The front door and bus-stop lights are behind Eli

characters.name: Mara
characters.objective: Get Eli to board the last bus with her
characters.opposition: Eli refuses to state that he has chosen his father over her
characters.stakes: If he stays, their relationship ends without either of them naming it
characters.subtext: She is asking whether she matters more than his fear of leaving

characters.name: Eli
characters.objective: Make Mara leave without forcing him to say no
characters.opposition: The bus ticket makes his passive choice visible
characters.stakes: Leaving betrays his dependent father; staying loses Mara
characters.subtext: He wants her to absolve him by making the decision herself

beats.action: Mara slides a bus ticket in a paper envelope halfway across the table
required_information: There is a ticket for Eli

dialogue.subtext: Please make me believe I did not wait for nothing

beats.purpose: Let Eli avoid the actual question
beats.action: Eli looks at the envelope but leaves it between them
beats.value_before: Mara can still read silence as uncertainty
beats.value_after: His refusal to touch the ticket begins to answer her

dialogue.text: You should get there before the rain.
dialogue.performance_note: Gentle and practical; no eye contact until the last word
dialogue.subtext: I am not coming, and I want you to spare me from saying it

beats.purpose: Mara understands and ends the negotiation
beats.action: Mara withdraws her hand, leaving the envelope in the exact center of the table
beats.value_before: She is waiting for his choice
beats.value_after: She accepts that he has already made it

dialogue.performance_note: A small breath before the line; no accusation
dialogue.subtext: I finally understand that I am leaving alone

setup_payoff.setup: The sealed envelope is introduced as an offered future
setup_payoff.payoff: It remains unopened when the relationship ends

constraints: No melodramatic crying or raised voices
Neither character leaves the booth during the scene

metadata.story_structure_skill_omitted: Single-scene dry run does not require feature or sequence restructuring
